summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new billing paywall, Stripe integration, dashboard tour, language toggle (EN/ES), theme toggle with favicon switching, and payday image generation. Backend API gates working correctly with 402 responses. All major features functional with minor Escape key handling issue in paywall dialog.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the paywall dialog when pressed
ui_bugs.details: The GlassDialog component's Escape key handler may not be working correctly. Close button and scrim click work fine. This affects keyboard accessibility.
ui_bugs.workaround: Users can click the X button or click outside the dialog to close

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix Escape key handler in PaywallSheet/GlassDialog component to properly close the dialog when Escape is pressed. The Dialog component's onEscapeKeyDown or keyboard event handling may need adjustment. Close button and scrim click work correctly.

billing_gate.details: HTTPOnly cookie 'gapless_demo_access' is created on /billing/status. Protected endpoints (actions, settings, buy, invoices, plan/explain, demo/simulate) correctly return 402 with message 'Monthly demo access is needed'. Read-only endpoints (forecast, plan, summary, offers) remain free.

stripe_integration.details: Stripe TEST checkout session creation works correctly. Returns valid checkout.stripe.com URL with cs_test_ session ID. Origin header validation working. Full payment flow not tested (requires actual Stripe checkout completion).

dashboard_tour.details: 3-step tour with spotlight highlighting, next/back navigation, skip/close buttons, Escape key support, and localStorage persistence. Tour appears automatically on first visit and doesn't repeat after completion.

language_toggle.details: EN/ES toggle on landing page with full translation of hero, stats, steps, features, testimonial, pricing, and footer. document.lang attribute updates, localStorage persistence, no horizontal overflow.

theme_toggle.details: Light/dark theme toggle with instant favicon switching (/favicon-light.svg vs /favicon-dark.svg), data-theme attribute, theme-color meta tag, localStorage persistence, works on both landing and dashboard.

paywall_dialog.details: GlassDialog opens correctly, displays price ($19 USD), benefits, test mode badge. Close button and scrim click work. Escape key does NOT close dialog (keyboard accessibility issue).

payday_image.details: Backend correctly returns 409 when payroll not covered. PNG generation endpoint exists and validates coverage before generating image.

mobile_responsive.details: No horizontal overflow on 390x844 mobile viewport. Paywall dialog properly sized for mobile. Dashboard and landing pages responsive.
